CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT 
 This Construction Management Agreement ( the “ Construction Management A greement” ) is made on the [●] day of January , 202 3 ( “Effective Date” ) at [●] , by and between : 
 M/S EDZD DEVELOP ER S , a partnership firm incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan with its registered office at 94-B/1, Pearl One, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg – III, Lahore , acting through its duly authorized representative [●] ( the “ Developer ” ) which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ) 
 AND 
 ZAMEEN DEVELOPMENTS (PVT) LIMITED, a company incorporated and existing under the laws of Pakistan with its registered office at 94-B/1, Pearl One, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg – III, Lahore , acting through its duly authorized representative [●] ( the “ Construction Mana gement Company ” ) which expression shall, where the context so admits, mean and include its successors-in-interest and permitted assigns ) 
 
 ( The Developer and the Construction Mana gement Company shall also individually be referred to as “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties ”) 
 
 WHEREAS 
 The Developer is undertaking a real estate project, name d and style d as “ Grande Palladium ” measuring 2895.9 Sq. Yards located at Plot No. 95 – E, Bahria Paradise Commercial, Rawalpindi ( hereinafter referred as the “ Project ”) ; 
 
 The Construction Management Company is in business of providing management services with respect to management of construction and engineering works of the nature and complexity equivalent to the construction at the Project Site ; and 
 
 The Parties are desirous to enter into this Construction Management Agreement for performance of Services by the Construction Management Company with respect to the management, coordination and overseeing the construction and development of the Project on the Project site (defined below) as per the terms and conditions of this Construction Management Agreement . 
 
 NOW, THEREFORE , the Parties, intending to be legally bound, agree to the terms and conditions set forth in this Construction Management Agreement. 
 
 TERM &amp; SCOPE 
 
 T he term of this Construction Management Agreement shall be effective form the Effective Date until such time the Parties have fully discharged their obligations hereunder, subject to the terms and conditions below (“ Term ”) . 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall provide management services with respect to the construction and development of the Project and to ensure that the c onstruction on the Project is completed as per the drawings, design and industry standards . Moreover, the Construction Management Company shall conduct regular quality control of the material being used at the Project Site . 
 
 The following documents (duly acknowledged) together shall constitute the complete agreement between the Parties hereto in respect of the provision of the Construction Management Company ’s s ervices , all of which shall form an integral part of th e Construction Management Agreement: 
 
 General Terms and Conditions; 
 Annexure A: Construction Management Company ’s Services ; 
 Annexure B: Services Fee’s Payment Mechanism ; 
 Annexure C: Project Plans and Specifications ; and 
 Annexure D: Schedule of Work . 
 
 SERVICES 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall provide management services with respect to the construction and development of the Project as fully described in Annexure A ( the “Services” ) . In this regard, t he Construction Management Company shall devise and implement effective mechanisms and systems for maintaining constant and regular checks to ensure that the c onstruction is being carried out as per the drawings, design, industry standards and conduct quality control of the material being used for the Construction . 
 
 SERVICE FEE 
 
 In consideration of the Services performed by Construction Management Company under this Construction Management Agreement , the Developer shall pay to the Construction Management Company a fee equivalent to Rs. [●] in the manner prescribed in Annexure B of this Construction Management Agreement. 
 
 REPRESENTATIONS AND WARRANTIES 
 The Parties represent and warrant that the Parties: 
 
 Have lawful authority and capacity to enter into this Construction Management Agreement and the transaction(s) contemplated hereunder; and 
 
 entering into, and performance of the obligations of the Party under this Construction Management Agreement does not and shall not violate, and is not inconsistent with, any agreements between such Party and any third -parties or any applicable laws or regulations, 
 
 the Party shall comply with the requirements of any and all applicable federal, state, local, and other laws, regulations, rules and orders of any governmental body having jurisdiction over such Party or the activities of such Party stated hereunder. 
 The Construction Management Company hereby represents and warrants that the Construction Management Company : 
 
 has good market standing, experience, requisite skill, knowledge and resources regarding management of Construction , development and engineering works at the P roject sites and has the ability to perform Services under this Construction Management Agreement. 
 
 shall take all the reasonable steps to ensure that the Services provided by the Construction Management Company under this Construction Management Agreement are fit for intended purpose and in accordance with industry standards. 
 The Construction Management Company undertakes to familiarise itself with the contracts between the Developer and the contractors, sub-contractors and the suppliers or any related contracts thereof , in order to ensure that the c onstruction on the Project s ite is carried out in the manner provided therein. 
 
 NOTICES 
 
 All notices, approvals, consents, waivers, directions, requests or communications must be in writing and signed by the Party giving the same and, except for construction related communications in the normal course, which may be by email, will be deemed properly given only if hand delivered or sent through courier as follows:

 or to such other address as a Party may from time to time designate in writing to the other Party as provided above. Notices will be deemed given upon receipt or refusal of delivery. 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND ARBITRATION 
 This Construction Management Agreement and the rights and obligations of the Parties are governed by and will be construed and enforced in accordance with the laws of Pakistan. 
 
 I n case any dispute or difference arises between the Parties in connection with this Construction Management Agreement or the transactions contemplated herein, the Parties undertake to use all reasonable endeavours, in good faith, to settle the dispute through negotiations. In the event the Parties are unable to resolve any dispute within thirty (30) days of its arising, then the dispute will be submitted for arbitration by an arbitration panel composed of three (3) arbitrators. Such arbitration shall be conducted under the Arbitration Act 1940, in the English language, at Lahore. The award of the arbitrator shall be final and binding upon both the Parties including the decision of its costs.

 GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS 
 DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION 
 
 Construction means the development, technical supervision, engineering and construction supervision, supervision at the design stage, quality controls, implementation of the Project and management services, which includes without limitation the entire Project management, detailed supervision of the Works and coordination between consultants and c ontractors, to achieve complete construction and development of the Project in accordance with the Project Plans and Specifications and the Schedule of Works. 
 
 Construction Cost means any and all direct costs and expenditures incurred in connection with the Construction, finishing and engineering of the Project, including the amounts to be paid on account of Project Approvals and any other charges of governmental authority( ies ). 
 
 Project Approvals means no objection or similar certificate s for transfer of title of Project l and and any and all approvals and authorizations related to planning , development and construction of the Project, MEP, drainage, sewage and structural drawings, required from any Government authority( ies ) with respect to the Project. 
 
 Project Plans and Specifications means the project plans and specification as specified in Annexure C . 
 
 Project Site means the places provided by the Developer where the Construction is to be executed and any other places as may be specifically designated in the construction contract of the Project, as forming part of the construction site. 
 
 Schedule of Works means the time frames set out for the completion of the Project, as mutually agreed upon by the Parties . 
 
 Services means all services to be perform by the Construction Management Company under this Construction Management Agreement, as more specifically detailed in Annexure A . 
 
 Works means all the work relating to excavation, construction, completion and finishing of the Project by the contractors or sub-contractors in accordance with their respective agreements including the provision of raw materials and remedying and removal of all defects identified by the Developer or the Developer’s engineer. 
 
 
 Except where the context otherwise requires, references in the Construction Management Agreement to: 
 
 Any headings in the Construction Management Agreement are for ease of reference only and are not to be taken into account in construction or interpretation; 
 
 Any statute or other legislative provision shall be read to include any statutory or legislative modification, amendment or re-enactment thereof; 
 
 Words denoting one gender shall include all other genders; 
 
 Words denoting singular shall, where the context permits, include plural; 
 
 No rule of construction shall apply to the disadvantage of a Party because that Party was responsible for the preparation of the Construction Management Agreement or any part of the Construction Management Agreement; 
 
 An obligation on a Party to do any act, matter or thing include an obligation to procure that it is done and words placing a Party under a restriction include an obligation not to permit or allow infringement of the restriction. 
 
 “law” includes any law, by-law, regulation (including any rule, official directive, request or guideline), legislation (including delegated legislation), constitution, decree, judgment, court order/authority of competent jurisdiction, ordinance, statute, treaty or other legislative measure of any governmental body or any Competent Authority; 
 
 INDEMNITY 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall indemnify, defend and hold harmless the Developer, its affiliates, successors and assigns and each of their officers, directors, shareholders and employees from and against all third party ) liabilities, claims, costs, damages, losses, or expenses (including legal fees and expenses) which arise out of or relate to any act, error or omission on the part of the Construction Management Company , any representation of the Construction Management Company herein being incorrect, misleading, incomplete, false or breach of warranty or of any obligation hereunder by the Construction Management Company . 
 
 CONFIDENTIALITY 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall not disclose, without prior written approval from the Developer, any information regarding this Construction Management Agreement, including the contents of this Construction Management Agreement and/or the any other agreement shared by the Developer with respect to the understanding of Developer with the contractors and sub-contractors. 
 
 TERMINATION 
 
 This Construction Management Agreement shall be effective and valid unless terminated in the manner set out below: 
 
 Through mutual consent of both Parties in writing. 
 
 In the event of a default by the Construction Management Company the Developer may terminate this Construction Management Agreement and designate another firm to assume the role of the Construction Management Company for the Construction. The following events shall constitute a default by the Construction Management Company : 
 
 Any material representation or warranty by the Construction Management Company in this Construction Management Agreement is false or misleading in a material respect; 
 The Construction Management Company commits fraud towards the Developer; or 
 The Construction Management Company fails to perform or fulfill any of its obligations under this Construction Management Agreement and the failure continues uncured for more than [●] days after written notice thereof by the Developer to the Construction Management Company specifying such default. 
 
 If this Construction Management Agreement is terminated the Construction Management Company will not be entitled to receive any further Service Fee under this Construction Management Agreement. Provided that the Construction Management Company will be paid all the Service Fee due and payable prior to such termination. 
 
 FORCE MAJEURE 
 
 Neither Party shall be liable to perform any of its obligations under this Construction Management Agreement and such obligations shall be extended by a period reasonable under the circumstances if the performance thereof is prevented or delayed due to any cause beyond the affected Party's reasonable control which, without in any way limiting the generality of the foregoing, shall include acts of God, riots, wars, national emergencies, acts of terrorism, epidemic/pandemic, accidents, lockdowns, embargo, industrial disputes or requisition. 
 
 ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Construction Management Company may not assign its rights or obligations hereunder without the prior written consent of the Developer. Subject to the above restriction, this Construction Management Agreement is binding upon the Construction Management Company and their respective successors and assigns. 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 This Construction Management Agreement embodies the entire agreement and understanding among the Parties relating to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior agreements and understandings related to such subject matter, and it is agreed that there are no terms, understandings, representations or warranties, express or implied, relating to such subject matter other than those set forth herein. 
 
 RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE PARTIES 
 
 Nothing contained in this Construction Management Agreement shall be construed or deemed to create any association, agency or employer-employee relationship in any manner whatsoever between the Parties. 
 
 TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE 
 
 Time is of the essence in all aspects of the performance of the obligations hereunder. 
 
 WAIVER 
 
 No failure by the Developer or the Construction Management Company to insist on the strict performance of any obligation, covenant, agreement, term or condition of this Construction Management Agreement, or to exercise any right or remedy available upon a breach of this Construction Management Agreement, will constitute a waiver, and no breach will be waived, altered or modified, except by a written instrument. 
 
 SEVERABILITY 
 
 The provisions of this Construction Management Agreement are severable. If any one or more provisions of this Construction Management Agreement or any part thereof are declared or adjudged to be illegal or invalid or unenforceable under any applicable law, such illegality, invalidity or unenforceability shall not invalidate the other provisions herein, which shall remain in full force and effect, and the Parties shall substitute the affected provisions in such a way that to the maximum extent possible the substitution carries out the original intent of the Parties as to the point or points in question. 
 
 GOOD FAITH 
 
 Each Party shall in good faith perform their obligations under this Construction Management Agreement based on confidence placed by such Party in the other and thereon relied upon by such Party. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 This Construction Management Agreement may be executed in multiple counterparts, each of which is an original and all of which together constitute one and the same document.

 Annexure A 
 Construction Management Company ’s Services 
 The Construction Management Company shall be providing the following services under this Construction Management Agreement: 
 
 
 PROJECT PLAN 
 
 Detailed Level-4 Construction Program of the whole project loaded with cost / resource on primavera, P-6 or on any other software mutually agreed amongst the parties. 
 
 Construction Methodology and Resources. 
 
 Procurement Plan for the whole project with timelines based upon Level-4 Planning. 
 
 Site facilities / camp for Project Management Team. 
 
 MONTHLY REPORT 
 
 The Construction Management Company will provide to the Developer a detailed monthly progress report on or before 8 th day of the following month which shall include: 
 
 A Schedule of the Project Site indicating the monthly progress in percentage, specifically providing a description and quantum of all the Construction works carried out since the last report. 
 
 Description of the material required for carrying the Construction as planned for the next forty-five (45) days and ninety (90) days for long lead items 
 
 Monthly summary of daily job record s (manpower, equipment, tools, plants and other resources ) 
 
 Photographs of the Construction Site to illustrate progress to the Developer . 
 
 H indrances and proposed resolutions for upcoming construction activities 
 
 Project Management Documents as per the requirements of Developer 
 
 Summ a ry of Payments claimed and disbursed to the Contractors 
 
 CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT COMPANY ’S SERVICES 
 
 The Construction Management Company will use commercially reasonable efforts and devise mechanisms to ensure that the Construction is completed in a timely manner as per the Schedule of Works. In this regard, the Construction Management Company shall provide assistance to the contractor(s), sub-contractor(s) and the consultant(s) with regards to the completion of the Construction as per the Plans and Specifications . 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall be responsible for verifying the monthly inspection reports and verifying the ‘S hop Drawings’ &amp; ‘As-Built’ drawings submitted by the Contractors employed for various work activities including but not limited to grey structure, MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) works, finishing works and infrastructure . 
 
 The Construction Management Company will coordinate with concerned utility companies for the installation of the utilities and to obtain any Project Approvals from the relevant authority . 
 
 The Construction Management Company will prepare a soils grading plan acceptable to both Developer and the Construction Management Company , pursuant to which an amount of displaced soils moved during the Construction are relocated on the Property, on adjacent properties within the larger project controlled by the Construction Management Company or its affiliates, and assure that such relocation of displaced soils is in accordance with rules and regulations applicable . 
 
 INSPECTION AND DEFECTS LIABILITY 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall carry out continuous inspection of the Construction and shall notify the Developer within [●] days if the Construction Management Company finds any defect at the Project Site or if the Construction Management Company finds any alteration necessary to be made in the Plans and Specifications. 
 
 The Construction Management Company will promptly notify the Developer when the Construction Management Company considers the Construction to be substantially complete. Pursuant to the issuance of such notice, the Construction Management Company and if the Developer desires, representatives of the Developer may inspect the Construction with the Construction Management Company to prepare a punch list of unfinished items for submission to the applicable contractor. The Construction Management Company will coordinate and administer the completion of all items on the punch list by the contractor within [●] days of the preparation of the punch list. 
 
 The Construction Management Company s all hold contractors and sub-contractors, if any, liable for a period of [●] months after the completion of the Construction for the defects in the works carried out by the contractor’s and sub contractor’s in the Construction. 
 
 TAKING OVER AND INTERIM PAYMENT CERTIFICATES 
 
 Prior to the issuance of the stage-wise Taking Over Certificate(s) ( the “ TOC ”) Construction Management Company shall assure that the contractor(s) and subcontractor(s) have carried out the construction works on the Project Site in a workmanlike and timely manner as per the Schedule of Works. The Construction Management Company shall maintain all TOC s of contractors and sub-contractors on a stage-wise completion of the Construction of the Project. 
 
 Any Interim Payment Certificate ( the “ IPC ”) issued to the contractors, sub-contractors, and suppliers for carrying out the Construction works on the Project Site would be duly signed &amp; approved by the authorized representative of the Construction Management Company . The issuance of the IPC(s) should be supported by measurement sheets as per actual work done against which the said payment is being made to the contractor, sub-contractors or suppliers . 
 
 HEALTH AND SAFETY 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall at times take all reasonable precautions to prevent any unlawful riotous or disorderly conduct by anyone, employees and labor and for the preservation of peace and protection of persons and property in the neighborhood of the Project Site. 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall devise mechanism to ensure the safety of all staff and labour working at the Project Site throughout the term of this Construction Management Agreement. 
 
 The Construction Management Company shall notify the Developer immediately by the quickest available means, the details of any accidents as soon as possible after its occurrence. In the case of any fatality or serious accident the Construction Management Company must ensure that the contractor take s appropriate action(s) required under the applicable law. 
 
 Annexure B 
 Services Fee’s Payment 
 Service Fee’s Payment Mechanism : 
 
 The Construction Management Company will invoice the Developer on a monthly basis and the Developer shall pay and clear such invoices within [●] days from the date of such invoice. 
 
 Any dispute or objection in respect of any invoice of the Manager shall be intimated to the Construction Management Company in writing within [●] days from the date of invoice. Within [●] days of the resolution of any objection, the Developer shall pay and clear such invoice within [●] days from the date of the resolution of such dispute. 
 
 All payment to the Construction Management Company shall be made through a crossed cheque or pay order/bank draft in favour of “ [●] ”. 
 
 During the last quarter of the project, Developer will do the evaluation to ascertain the actual / estimated Project Completion Cost, and adjustments if any regarding the remuneration will be made accordingly. The Developer will decide about the remuneration (if any) for any additional tasks and the extended period due to prolonged suspension of work, on account of any reason beyond the control of the Construction Management Company . Accumulated short suspensions (not more than [●] days at time), at different occasions (total [●] days) during the entire project time will not be claimed by the Construction Management Company .
